svg.text: A frame strip shows growth. This one asks where the fern is still claiming genuinely new coarse area.
Bright cells are new in that interval. Dark green cells were already claimed earlier. The claim front climbs upward, then thins into leaflet edges.
stem and lower spine claim first
the first side leaves stop looking accidental
upper canopy keeps doing the real claiming
novelty slides to the leaflet fringe
late claims mostly live on outer lace
the last gains are edge polish, not new bulk
Each bar is the new coarse area claimed in that interval, not the full fern already on screen.
Blue = mean height of newly claimed cells. Mint = share of those new cells already in the upper canopy.
Peak new-area interval: 5200→12000 (8.6% of all coarse cells). Highest claim front: 320→900 at mean height 6.09. Final cumulative occupancy: 37.5%.
